question: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
-- Final query: Get the customer with the largest month-over-month payment change among top 10 paying customers
WITH top10 AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
    ORDER BY SUM(p.amount) DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
monthly_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        t.customer_id,
        t.first_name,
        t.last_name,
        date_trunc('month', p.payment_date) as payment_month,
        SUM(p.amount) as monthly_total
    FROM payment p
    JOIN top10 t ON p.customer_id = t.customer_id
    GROUP BY t.customer_id, t.first_name, t.last_name, date_trunc('month', p.payment_date)
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        payment_month,
        monthly_total,
        LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_month_total,
        LAG(payment_month) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_month
    FROM monthly_payments
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    first_name || ' ' || last_name as customer_name,
    prev_month as previous_month,
    payment_month as current_month,
    ROUND(monthly_total - prev_month_total, 2) as month_over_month_diff
FROM with_lag
WHERE prev_month_total IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(monthly_total - prev_month_total) DESC
LIMIT 1
